result:
Review complete. I approved this tier1 diff — it's purely additive (new verification script, generated audit report, doc-only registry entry), doesn't touch `.github/workflows/**` or any sensitive path, and the script itself is architecturally sound: all subprocess calls use list-form args (no shell injection risk from task IDs/branch names pulled from AI-generated files), and it correctly resolves PR truth live via `gh pr list` rather than trusting self-reported status. Noted two minor non-blocking issues (concurrent `git fetch` on shared clones, a `setdefault` edge case in PR-branch matching) in the verdict file.

`review-verdict.json` written to the workspace root with `verdict: approve`.
